description: This file defines a Java class 'ComparableRange' that represents a range of comparable values with methods for comparison, inclusion, overlap checks, and other range-related functionalities.

classes.name: ComparableRange
classes.description: A generic class for representing a range of comparable values with methods to check containment, overlap, and comparison operations.

methods.name: getStart
methods.description: Retrieves the start value of the range.

methods.name: getEnd
methods.description: Retrieves the end value of the range.

methods.name: ComparableRange
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the range with start and end values, ensuring start is less than or equal to end.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Checks if this range is entirely after another range or value.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Checks if this range is entirely before another range or value.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns the end value of the range.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on start and end values.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this range with another for ordering based on start and end values.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if a range or a value is included within this range.

methods.name: isPoint
methods.description: Indicates if this range represents a single point.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Determines if this range overlaps with another range.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Returns the start value of the range.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the range.
